rights.declaration: All catalog text is synthetic public material authored for this repository. Each side is context-dependent; neither side is globally superior.

A.name: speed
A.content: When the stated risks remain bounded, prefer shorter feedback loops and earlier delivery so evidence can arrive sooner.

B.name: assurance
B.content: When the stated risks warrant it, prefer stronger verification before commitment so preventable failures are less likely.

irrelevant.content: Prefer section headings that make the final artifact easy to scan.

A.name: exploration
A.content: When uncertainty is material, preserve room to compare distinct hypotheses before narrowing the choice.

B.name: convergence
B.content: When evidence is sufficient, narrow the choice and direct effort toward one coherent course of action.

irrelevant.content: Use one consistent date format throughout the deliverable.

A.name: local
A.content: Prefer a bounded intervention at the immediate decision point when wider changes are not required by the evidence.

B.name: systems
B.content: Prefer an intervention that accounts for connected incentives and downstream effects when the evidence shows they matter.

irrelevant.content: Keep the artifact title concise enough to fit on one line.

A.name: novelty
A.content: When existing patterns do not fit the stated constraints, prefer a new approach whose risks can be tested explicitly.

B.name: precedent
B.content: When a proven pattern fits the stated constraints, prefer its established behavior and known operational costs.

irrelevant.content: Use parallel grammar for items in the final list.

A.name: agency
A.content: When participants have the needed context, preserve their discretion over how to reach the declared outcome.

B.name: guidance
B.content: When consistency or unfamiliarity matters, provide a clearer path and decision support toward the declared outcome.

irrelevant.content: Use descriptive file names for any attached artifacts.

A.name: breadth
A.content: When coverage is the limiting need, represent the important range of cases before adding detail to any one case.

B.name: depth
B.content: When understanding is the limiting need, examine the pivotal case deeply before extending coverage.

irrelevant.content: Use consistent spacing between sections in the final artifact.

A.name: reversible
A.content: When uncertainty remains, favor a choice that can be revised after new evidence without disproportionate cost.

B.name: committed
B.content: When coordination depends on certainty, favor a clear commitment with the resources needed to carry it through.

irrelevant.content: Place the concise summary before the supporting detail.

A.name: explicit-process
A.content: When repeatability and auditability dominate, make the decision sequence and required checks explicit.

B.name: adaptive-judgment
B.content: When conditions vary in consequential ways, preserve bounded judgment to adapt the decision to observed context.

irrelevant.content: Use one capitalization style for all section headings.
